findings.title: Reachable Prey Makes Hidden Restraint Visible
findings.claim: Within the lawful-hunt pericope, game that can be reached by hands and spears is the concrete opportunity through which God-directed fear in the unseen becomes visible as restraint.
findings.mechanism: The focus joins testing, hunting, attainment, hand, spear, fear, and the unseen; 5:87, 5:95, 5:96, and 5:99 then distinguish lawful provision, consecrated prohibition, deliberate breach, and revealed or concealed conduct, so physical access becomes the test's affordance rather than permission.
findings.reader_payoff: The reason for making the prey reachable becomes perceptible: the hidden disposition is exposed at the moment an available strike is withheld.
findings.containment: The ordinary hunting test and its penalty remain intact; this does not turn every reach or weapon into a symbol and does not claim a blanket ban on food or hunting.

epistemic.reason: The channel support is trusted, and the native pericope supplies exact contextual forms that materially specify the relation.

findings.title: Unseen Fear Functions as Anticipated Review
findings.claim: The focus's unseen-directed fear can be newly understood as present restraint before a review that is not yet visible: the pericope's testimony procedure makes concealed conduct answerable through testimony, doubt, replacement, and returned oaths.
findings.mechanism: The focus pairs fear and hiddenness with transgression; 5:106-5:108 supply concealment, uncertainty, testimony, replacement witnesses, and explicit fear of later reversal, providing a concrete procedural analogue for unseen accountability.
findings.reader_payoff: The invisible criterion becomes an intelligible social pattern: conduct is restrained now because later scrutiny can expose and reverse it.
findings.containment: This is attributed legacy_unbound HFT evidence and an analogy, not an assertion that the witness procedure defines the theological object of fear or replaces the focus's devotional meaning.

epistemic.reason: The supplied testimony coordinates and focus return are exact, while the HFT record itself marks the relation as an analogue rather than a definition.

findings.title: Refused Restraint Returns as Consequence
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the focus's punishment term can also be heard as the forced return of restraint: the voluntary abstention that was refused reappears in 5:95 as imposed abstention and experienced burden.
findings.mechanism: The focus's punishment and pain supply the ordinary consequence; 5:95 places fasting, tasting, and burden in the compensatory sequence, while the attributed restraint branch of ع ذ ب links withholding to imposed consequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The penalty appears as a consequence that reproduces the form of restraint the agent would not supply freely rather than as unrelated pain added after the test.
findings.containment: This is exploratory, branch-distant, and attributed. The ordinary punitive meaning of عذاب أليم remains primary; the analogy does not claim that punishment literally means fasting or that every consequence reproduces the offense.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates are exact and the packet supplies explicit containment, but the relation activates a branch-distant restraint image through a multi-step analogy.

findings.title: The Fatiha Contact Gives Divine Knowing a Wider Field
findings.claim: The added Fatiha phrase gives the focus's divine knowing a bounded scope: the person disclosed by the test is known by the one named alongside the worlds.
findings.mechanism: The focus's يَعْلَمَ carries the supplied knowledge branch, while external 1:2 contributes عَالَمِينَ through the same ع ل م root; that exact contact supplies a created-totality frame without changing the focus verb into a noun for worlds.
findings.reader_payoff: The test's disclosure becomes perceptible as a local act within a wider field of divine knowledge rather than as a detached inspection.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory external overlay. It does not transfer the worlds branch to the focus form, infer a whole-Fatiha thesis, or claim a cosmological purpose absent from the packet.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus QAC occurrence and external context root/word occurrence are supplied, but the overlay's scope effect is an inference from that contact rather than a supplied prose support record.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus knowledge verb carries divine knowing of the person disclosed by the test.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: External 1:2's العالمين names the created totality through the same ع ل م root.
branch_activations.activation: The external worlds occurrence contacts the focus knowledge occurrence through the shared root, widening the field of what divine knowing is framed against while preserving the focus's verbal form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The tested person's hidden fear is known within the frame of the worlds, not as an isolated human datum.
branch_activations.boundary: The external word supplies scale only; it does not make the focus verb mean worlds or establish a whole-surah thesis.
